mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) indicates inflationary pressures, which typically lead to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL increases by more than 0.5% in a month
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL increases sharply but the S&P 500 shows positive returns in more than 50% of the subsequent 20-day periods.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) suggests a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequently higher interest rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE decreases by more than 0.3 percentage points in a month
failure_condition: If UNRATE drops significantly but the S&P 500 shows positive returns in more than 60% of the subsequent 60-day periods.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates growing demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases but the S&P 500 shows negative returns in more than 60% of the subsequent 5-day periods.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a slowdown in economic activity, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO decreases by more than 0.5% in a month
failure_condition: If INDPRO decreases but the S&P 500 shows positive returns in more than 60% of the subsequent 20-day periods.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4%, it indicates a restrictive monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS is above 4% but the S&P 500 shows positive returns in more than 60% of the subsequent 60-day periods.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) suggests strong labor market conditions, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases but the S&P 500 shows negative returns in more than 60% of the subsequent 20-day periods.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, which is a positive signal for economic growth and S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases by more than 1% in a month
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases significantly but the S&P 500 shows negative returns in more than 60% of the subsequent 5-day periods.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) combined with an increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) suggests accommodative monetary policy in the face of inflation, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases and CPIAUCSL increases but the S&P 500 shows negative returns in more than 60% of the subsequent 60-day periods.
